title: Project sync: resolve short milestone aliases to full GitHub milestone titles
spec: The GitHub project sync command accepts a --milestone filter, but users pass short aliases like "M2" while the GitHub milestones have full titles like "M2 - Local Agent Discovery", so the filter matches nothing. Make the sync command resolve a short milestone alias to the full milestone title before filtering issues, falling back to the raw value when there is no match. Add a self-check assertion that a short alias resolves to the full title.
